[[Image:Triangle-icon.svg|thumb|right|100px|This chapter icon represents the Traitor's Court at the White Tower.]]
'''Traitor's Court''' is an area in the [[White Tower]] in [[Tar Valon]] where executions, stillings and gentlings take place.

During [[Egwene]]'s test for accepted after she has gone through the third arch she is informed that [[Rand]] is being taken here to be gentled.{{ref/book|3|22}}

After being captured in the [[Stone of Tear]], [[Amico Nagoyin]] and [[Joiya Byir]] are scheduled to be shipped to Tar Valon for stilling and execution.{{ref/book|4|6}}.
